mobbin:40bd9265-6569-49af-a402-77cd8de34.summary: From Teams, an admin adds a team event type, chooses Collective, Round Robin or Managed assignment, sets maximize-availability versus load-balancing, and sees the Collective event on the Event Types list.
steps: Teams hub: Collective or round-robin tip
Add team event: Collective, Round Robin, Managed
Title and URL slug for Team Quick Chat
Assignment: maximize vs load balancing; fixed hosts
Assignment saved; Add all team members off
Event Types list: Team Quick Chat, Collective
steal: Assignment is chosen at create: Collective (all available), Round Robin (cycle) or Managed (bulk distribute) (screens 2 to 4).
Distribution offers Maximize availability versus Load balancing in plain language (screens 5 to 6).
Fixed hosts plus 'Add all team members, including future members' is a switch on the same screen (screen 6).
A list label shows the scheduling type (Collective) beside duration (screen 7).
avoid: A deep event settings sidebar (Setup, Availability, Limits, Advanced) is heavy for a simple session type.
mobbin:40bd9265-6569-49af-a402-77cd8de34.fit: Scheduling: matches baseline faculty rotation (collective panel versus round-robin pool). Use for multi-faculty scenario runs without rebuilding OSCE complexity.

mobbin:23bf0af9-943c-4ed2-ad8f-6203131d5.summary: An invitee picks duration and date/time on the public booking page, fills name, email, location and custom fields, confirms, and lands on a recurring-booking success page with calendar add options.
steps: Booking page: duration, calendar, time slots
Confirm form: name, email, location, notes
Add to calendar providers plus spam warning
steal: Self sign-up uses three panes: details, month and slot list with green available dots (screens 1 to 5).
Duration labels change the offered slots before confirm (screens 1 to 2).
Occurrence validation shows a clear range error (screen 3).
Success shows a Host label, intake answers echoed, and Add to calendar (Google, Outlook, Office, ICS) (screens 8 to 9).
avoid: Letting the booker set 'Every week for N occurrences' on an onboarding-style event is easy to mis-set compared with a coordinator-owned series.
mobbin:23bf0af9-943c-4ed2-ad8f-6203131d5.fit: Scheduling: learner-side self sign-up into a capacity or slot model. Extend for sim session booking and Outlook write-back; not Excel bulk create.
